description: This file defines the PoolBuilder class responsible for constructing and managing fixture pools for test suites, including handling different test types and error management.

classes.name: PoolBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and managing fixture pools for test suites, supporting different modes ('loader' and 'worker') and handling errors.

methods.name: createForLoader
methods.description: Creates a PoolBuilder instance configured for loader mode.

methods.name: createForWorker
methods.description: Creates a PoolBuilder instance configured for worker mode with a specified project.

methods.name: buildPools
methods.description: Builds fixture pools for each test in a suite, assigning pools or digests based on mode.

methods.name: _buildPoolForTest
methods.description: Constructs a fixture pool for a specific test, including parent suite hooks and modifiers.

methods.name: _buildTestTypePool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a fixture pool for a specific test type.

methods.name: _handleLoadError
methods.description: Handles load errors by either appending to testErrors or throwing an error with formatted location.
